goal: Implement automated real-time GitHub release polling and backend caching API so users always download the latest update without rate limits or manual page updates

steps.title: Implement server-side GitHub release cache and direct 302 download redirect routes (/api/latest-releases, /download/dynamo, /download/guard) in server.js
steps.note: Verified server routes /api/latest-releases, /download/dynamo (302 redirect to latest DMG), and /download/guard with background auto-polling and zero rate-limit fallback

steps.title: Upgrade client-side js/github-releases.js with real-time auto-fetch polling, dynamic DOM badge updates, and live update status indicator
steps.note: Upgraded js/github-releases.js with automated 30s background polling, visibilitychange and focus triggers, live status indicator, and dynamic DOM version update pulse

steps.title: Update download button hrefs and badges in index.html, dynamo.html, and agent-guard.html to link to direct auto-redirect download endpoints
steps.note: Updated all download CTAs across index.html, dynamo.html, and agent-guard.html to use smart direct endpoints /download/dynamo and /download/guard with data-gh-download attributes

steps.title: Verify auto-fetch release API, direct 302 DMG download redirects, and live DOM synchronization on port 3000
steps.note: End-to-end verified /api/latest-releases cache, direct 302 redirects to latest GitHub DMG and releases, 30s background auto-polling loop, and DOM button bindings on port 3000
